title: Prologue to Ambrose: praying the twentieth tome from the Son’s fullness
english: As we dictate the twentieth tome on the Gospel according to John, most God-loving and most studious Ambrose in the Lord, we pray to receive full thoughts from [[the fullness of the Son of God, in whom it pleased all the fullness to dwell. >> Bible:Colossians 1:19]]
May God therefore send us the Word himself, making himself manifest, so that we may become beholders of his depth, the Father granting it.
translator_notes: OET. Pass A!=B. Heine not wording. Melito skipped. Never Cyril Matthew.

title: “I know you are Abraham’s seed” vs “If you were Abraham’s children”
english: [[“I know that you are Abraham’s seed; but you seek to kill me, because my word finds no place in you.” >> Bible:John 8:37]]

To those who do not distinguish the senses of “seed” and “child,” [[“I know you are Abraham’s seed” >> Bible:John 8:37]] will seem to clash with [[“If you are Abraham’s children, do the works of Abraham.” >> Bible:John 8:39]]
translator_notes: OET. Pass A!=B. Heine not wording. Melito skipped. Never Cyril Matthew.

title: Bodily difference of seed and child
english: So that this may be seen, let us first look bodily at the difference of seed and child. Clearly a seed holds the reasons of the sower still quiet and stored within it.
But a child comes to be when the seed has changed and worked the matter around it, having been formed and made ready for birth.
translator_notes: OET. Pass A!=B. Heine not wording. Melito skipped. Never Cyril Matthew.

title: Raising seed and child from bodies to souls
english: Let us hear all this by referring what is said not to bodies and bodily humans, but to souls and the dispositions in them.
For there is in a soul both Abraham’s seed and Abraham’s child; and not everyone who has the seed has already become a child.
translator_notes: OET. Pass A!=B. Heine not wording. Melito skipped. Never Cyril Matthew.

title: My word finds no place in you
english: [[“But you seek to kill me, because my word finds no place in you.” >> Bible:John 8:37]]
For the word to “find place” in someone is for him to receive it into the ruling faculty and become capacious of the thoughts of truth.
translator_notes: OET. Pass A!=B. Heine not wording. Melito skipped. Never Cyril Matthew.

title: Those who cannot contain the word
english: Those addressed seem not to contain the word, which cannot enter them because of vice.
As narrow vessels do not contain much wine, so a soul filled with desires does not contain the word.
translator_notes: OET. Pass A!=B. Heine not wording. Melito skipped. Never Cyril Matthew.

title: What I have seen with the Father I speak
english: [[“What I have seen with the Father I speak; and you, then, do what you have heard from the Father.” >> Bible:John 8:38]]
Ask in what way the Son has seen with the Father, and how those addressed hear from the Father.
translator_notes: OET. Pass A!=B. Heine not wording. Melito skipped. Never Cyril Matthew.

title: Against those who introduce natures
english: We would ask those who introduce natures how those who are children of the devil by nature are blamed as able to live otherwise.
If they are such by nature, they are rebuked in vain; if they are rebuked, they are such not by nature but by choice.
translator_notes: OET. Pass A!=B. Heine not wording. Melito skipped. Never Cyril Matthew.

title: If you are Abraham’s children, do Abraham’s works
english: They answered, [[“Our father is Abraham.” >> Bible:John 8:39]] Jesus said to them, [[“If you are Abraham’s children, do the works of Abraham.” >> Bible:John 8:39]]
Saying “Our father is Abraham” does not make children; doing Abraham’s works does.
translator_notes: OET. Pass A!=B. Heine not wording. Melito skipped. Never Cyril Matthew.

title: Abraham’s works: he believed God
english: Those who pick out one of Abraham’s works — [[“Abraham believed God, and it was counted to him as righteousness” >> Bible:Genesis 15:6]] — choose well.
Yet one must also seek the rest: departure from his land, offering of the son, hospitality, so that we may become Abraham’s children.
translator_notes: OET. Pass A!=B. Heine not wording. Melito skipped. Never Cyril Matthew.

title: This Abraham did not do
english: [[“But now you seek to kill me, a man who has told you the truth that I heard from God; this Abraham did not do.” >> Bible:John 8:40]]
It is a great thing not to do what Abraham did not do, and to do what he did. Those who seek to kill the one who speaks the truth are not Abraham’s children.
translator_notes: OET. Pass A!=B. Heine not wording. Melito skipped. Never Cyril Matthew.

title: You do the works of your father
english: You say, [[“We were not born of fornication; we have one Father, God.” >> Bible:John 8:41]] Jesus said, [[“If God were your Father, you would love me.” >> Bible:John 8:42]]
[[“You do the works of your father” >> Bible:John 8:41]] shows another father, whose works they seek to imitate.
translator_notes: OET. Pass A!=B. Heine not wording. Melito skipped. Never Cyril Matthew.

title: I came from God and I am here
english: [[“For I came from God and I am here; for I have not come of myself, but he sent me.” >> Bible:John 8:42]]
“Coming from God” is to be taken in a God-befitting way: not a change of place, but the Word’s generation from the Father.
translator_notes: OET. Pass A!=B. Heine not wording. Melito skipped. Never Cyril Matthew.

title: Why do you not understand my speech?
english: [[“Why do you not understand my speech? Because you cannot hear my word.” >> Bible:John 8:43]]
Speech and word differ: speech is ready to hand, the word deeper. Those who cannot contain the word do not even understand the speech.
translator_notes: OET. Pass A!=B. Heine not wording. Melito skipped. Never Cyril Matthew.

title: You are of your father the devil
english: [[“You are of your father the devil, and you want to do your father’s desires. He was a murderer from the beginning.” >> Bible:John 8:44]]
Some become children of the devil not by nature but by imitation and choice, doing his desires.
translator_notes: OET. Pass A!=B. Heine not wording. Melito skipped. Never Cyril Matthew.

title: He does not stand in the truth
english: [[“And he does not stand in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaks the lie, he speaks from his own, for he is a liar and the father of it.” >> Bible:John 8:44]]
The lie is the devil’s own. Christ is the truth, and [[whoever is of the truth hears his voice. >> Bible:John 18:37]]
translator_notes: OET. Pass A!=B. Heine not wording. Melito skipped. Never Cyril Matthew.

title: Because I speak the truth, you do not believe me
english: [[“But because I speak the truth, you do not believe me. Which of you convicts me concerning sin?” >> Bible:John 8:45-46]]
It is paradoxical that speaking the truth is the cause of unbelief; yet to lovers of lies the truth is distasteful.
translator_notes: OET. Pass A!=B. Heine not wording. Melito skipped. Never Cyril Matthew.

title: The one of God hears God’s words
english: [[“The one who is of God hears the words of God; for this reason you do not hear, because you are not of God.” >> Bible:John 8:47]]
The criterion of being of God is hearing God’s words; those who do not hear convict themselves.
translator_notes: OET. Pass A!=B. Heine not wording. Melito skipped. Never Cyril Matthew.

title: You have a demon; I do not have a demon
english: The Jews answered, [[“Are we not right in saying that you are a Samaritan and have a demon?” >> Bible:John 8:48]] Jesus answered, [[“I do not have a demon, but I honor my Father.” >> Bible:John 8:49]]
Those who blaspheme the Word call him Samaritan and demon-possessed; but the one who honors the Father does not have a demon.
translator_notes: OET. Pass A!=B. Heine not wording. Melito skipped. Never Cyril Matthew.

title: If anyone keeps my word, he will not see death forever
english: [[“Truly, truly, I say to you, if anyone keeps my word, he will never see death.” >> Bible:John 8:51]]
The cause of their not knowing his meaning is not keeping the word; the one who keeps it does not see eternal death.
translator_notes: OET. Pass A!=B. Heine not wording. Melito skipped. Never Cyril Matthew.

title: Ambiguous phrasing: of your father the devil
english: [[“You are of your father the devil, and you want to do your father’s desires.” >> Bible:John 8:44]]
The wording is ambiguous: either it means the devil has a father from whom these are, or — better — that you are of this father, of whom “devil” is predicated.
translator_notes: OET. Pass A!=B. Heine not wording. Melito skipped. Never Cyril Matthew.

title: Not a father of the devil beside the liar
english: One who argues for a father of the devil will use [[“When he speaks the lie… he is a liar and the father of it.” >> Bible:John 8:44]]
But that is not sound. Better to fit “the lie” to the opposite of [[“I am the truth” >> Bible:John 14:6]] — the antichrist — whose father is the devil.
translator_notes: OET. Pass A!=B. Heine not wording. Melito skipped. Never Cyril Matthew.

title: Every son wants to do his father’s desires
english: Every son wants to do his own father’s desires and does his father’s works.
So also the Savior wants the Father’s desires; and [[the man of sin, the son of destruction, >> Bible:2 Thessalonians 2:3]] wants those of the father of destruction.
translator_notes: OET. Pass A!=B. Heine not wording. Melito skipped. Never Cyril Matthew.

title: Our works are either God’s or the devil’s
english: For us too, works are either God’s or the devil’s, and what we want to do is either desire of the good Father or of the enemy.
If we do God’s works, we are sons of God; if the devil’s, we are of the father the devil.
translator_notes: OET. Pass A!=B. Heine not wording. Melito skipped. Never Cyril Matthew.

title: Desire can be praiseworthy or base
english: Not every desire is blameworthy: [[the Lord’s judgments are more to be desired than gold, >> Bible:Psalm 19:10]] and the Savior said, [[“I have earnestly desired to eat this Passover with you.” >> Bible:Luke 22:15]]
Base is looking at a woman [[to desire her. >> Bible:Matthew 5:28]] So attend not only to what we do but to what we want.
translator_notes: OET. Pass A!=B. Heine not wording. Melito skipped. Never Cyril Matthew.

title: He was a murderer from the beginning
english: [[“He was a murderer from the beginning, and he does not stand in the truth.” >> Bible:John 8:44]]
“From the beginning” of murdering the human — not from the beginning of creation was he such, but when he stood away from the truth.
translator_notes: OET. Pass A!=B. Heine not wording. Melito skipped. Never Cyril Matthew.

title: Because I speak the truth you do not believe
english: [[“But because I speak the truth, you do not believe me.” >> Bible:John 8:45]]
Truth-lovers believe the truth; for lie-lovers, speaking the true itself becomes the cause of unbelief.
translator_notes: OET. Pass A!=B. Heine not wording. Melito skipped. Never Cyril Matthew.

title: Which of you convicts me of sin?
english: [[“Which of you convicts me concerning sin? If I tell the truth, why do you not believe me?” >> Bible:John 8:46]]
No one convicted him: [[he committed no sin, nor was deceit found in his mouth. >> Bible:1 Peter 2:22]]
translator_notes: OET. Pass A!=B. Heine not wording. Melito skipped. Never Cyril Matthew.

title: Whoever is of God hears the words of God
english: [[“Whoever is of God hears the words of God; for this reason you do not hear, because you are not of God.” >> Bible:John 8:47]]
[[“My sheep hear my voice.” >> Bible:John 10:27]] Those who are of God are known by hearing.
translator_notes: OET. Pass A!=B. Heine not wording. Melito skipped. Never Cyril Matthew.

title: The Jews’ retort and Jesus’ honor of the Father
english: The Jews answered, [[“Are we not right that you are a Samaritan and have a demon?” >> Bible:John 8:48]] He answered, [[“I do not have a demon, but I honor my Father, and you dishonor me.” >> Bible:John 8:49]]
The one who honors the Father does not have a demon; those who dishonor the Son do not honor the Father.
translator_notes: OET. Pass A!=B. Heine not wording. Melito skipped. Never Cyril Matthew.

title: To believers who still do not believe the truth
english: If we remember to whom the discourse is addressed — the Jews who had believed him — we will ask how he can say to such, [[“But because I speak the truth, you do not believe me.” >> Bible:John 8:45]]
Someone can believe under one aspect and not under another: for example, believing in the one crucified under Pontius Pilate, yet not believing in the one born of the virgin Mary.
translator_notes: OET. Pass A!=B. Heine not wording. Melito skipped. Never Cyril Matthew. Book 20 CLOSEOUT.

title: Who among you convicts me of sin?
english: When the word sets out its intent clearly, it shames those who will not assent: if you do not convict the sayings as sinful, you are reasonably required to assent.

Only our Lord, [[who did no sin >> Bible:1 Peter 2:22]] and [[was tempted in every respect as we are, yet without sin, >> Bible:Hebrews 4:15]] can say [[“Which of you convicts me concerning sin?” >> Bible:John 8:46]]
translator_notes: OET. Pass A!=B. Heine not wording. Melito skipped. Never Cyril Matthew. Book 20 CLOSEOUT.

title: Why we do not believe: unclean eyes of the soul
english: Someone might say: we do not believe because we do not yet see how what he says is truth; and we do not see because the soul’s truth-seeing eyes are not yet cleansed.
If we are not yet of God, the eyes of truth are covered over by vice.
translator_notes: OET. Pass A!=B. Heine not wording. Melito skipped. Never Cyril Matthew. Book 20 CLOSEOUT.

title: Against natures that alone can receive God’s words
english: Those who introduce different natures think to prove from this that only sons of God by nature can receive God’s words.
But [[as many as received the true light >> Bible:John 1:9]] did not receive it by already being of God: [[he gave them authority to become children of God. >> Bible:John 1:12]]
translator_notes: OET. Pass A!=B. Heine not wording. Melito skipped. Never Cyril Matthew. Book 20 CLOSEOUT.

title: One can become more a son of God than another
english: Paradoxically from the opposite side: one can be more a son of God than another — even twofold more.
According to progress and imitation of the one who [[loves enemies and blesses those who curse. >> Bible:Matthew 5:44]]
translator_notes: OET. Pass A!=B. Heine not wording. Melito skipped. Never Cyril Matthew. Book 20 CLOSEOUT.

title: Samaritan charge: dogmatic insult, not shared doctrine
english: It is likely that in unspoken talk they called him a Samaritan as one counterfeiting Jewish things like the Samaritans.
Ask how, when Samaritans deny the coming age, they dared call Samaritan the one who taught resurrection and judgment — perhaps as insult, not as shared dogma.
translator_notes: OET. Pass A!=B. Heine not wording. Melito skipped. Never Cyril Matthew. Book 20 CLOSEOUT.

title: I honor my Father; every word of Jesus is a leaf that does not fall
english: Clearly the Savior’s voice is [[“I honor the Father” >> Bible:John 8:49]] — which we should strive to say with conscience bearing witness.
Being himself [[the tree of life >> Bible:Proverbs 3:18]] as Wisdom, none of his words is to be taken casually; no leaf of his falls away.
translator_notes: OET. Pass A!=B. Heine not wording. Melito skipped. Never Cyril Matthew. Book 20 CLOSEOUT.

title: I do not seek my glory; there is one who seeks and judges
english: Next see [[“I do not seek my glory; there is one who seeks and judges.” >> Bible:John 8:50]]
God seeks in each who has received the Son the glory of Christ; not finding it, he judges those in whom he does not find it.
translator_notes: OET. Pass A!=B. Heine not wording. Melito skipped. Never Cyril Matthew. Book 20 CLOSEOUT.

title: If anyone keeps my word he will not see death forever
english: As there is an indifferent life and another that is a good — [[“I am the life” >> Bible:John 11:25]] — so there is an indifferent death and a death hostile to the one who said “I am the life.”
[[“If anyone keeps my word, he will never see death.” >> Bible:John 8:51]] He means the evil death.
translator_notes: OET. Pass A!=B. Heine not wording. Melito skipped. Never Cyril Matthew. Book 20 CLOSEOUT.

title: Sin and demons behind evil speech
english: Many think every kind of sin arises only from base judgments; but those who trust the holy Scriptures hold that deeds against right reason are not without demons.
Even sin in speech is not without the wicked agents at work.
translator_notes: OET. Pass A!=B. Heine not wording. Melito skipped. Never Cyril Matthew. Book 20 CLOSEOUT.

title: Abraham died — and the prophets
english: The Jews’ reply about Abraham and the prophets as having died seems, on the simpler reading, clear.
Did they think the Savior spoke without reason when he said [[“If anyone keeps my word, he will never see death,” >> Bible:John 8:51]] or did they grasp he was not speaking of the more common death?
translator_notes: OET. Pass A!=B. Heine not wording. Melito skipped. Never Cyril Matthew. Book 20 CLOSEOUT.

title: Death passed to all because all sinned
english: Likely they said [[“Abraham died, and the prophets,” >> Bible:John 8:52]] having learned how [[through one man sin entered the world, and death through sin. >> Bible:Romans 5:12]]
But they did not know that [[the gift is not like the trespass. >> Bible:Romans 5:15]]
translator_notes: OET. Pass A!=B. Heine not wording. Melito skipped. Never Cyril Matthew. Book 20 CLOSEOUT.

title: See death versus taste death
english: Though the Savior said [[“he will not see death,” >> Bible:John 8:51]] the Jews report what was not said: [[“he will not taste death.” >> Bible:John 8:52]]
There is a difference between not seeing death and not tasting death.
translator_notes: OET. Pass A!=B. Heine not wording. Melito skipped. Never Cyril Matthew. Book 20 CLOSEOUT.

title: Other senses of death; close of Book 20
english: If then there is a difference between tasting death and seeing death, the Jews as unintelligent hearers confused the Lord’s word.
You will also ask whether by the other senses one can hear or smell or touch death — the hands of false apostles handling the word of death. So much for the twentieth tome.
translator_notes: OET. Pass A!=B. Heine not wording. Melito skipped. Never Cyril Matthew. Book 20 CLOSEOUT.
